ai_summary: Airan Limited announced changes to its governance structure with the appointment of two new directors and M/S Supal Shah & Associates as the statutory auditor for a five-year term. These routine updates include an experienced banking professional appointed as an Independent Director, potentially enhancing board oversight and strategic guidance. A significant red flag is the material inconsistency regarding this director's status, as he is described as "Independent" in the main disclosure but "Non-Independent" in the annexure, which requires urgent clarification for regulatory compliance.
